'''Magno-grip boots''', also known as '''magnetized boots''', were [[Boot/Legends|boots]] with [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] technology that allowed the wear to magnetize themselves to the surface they were standing upon. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] utilized a pair and additionally outfitted them with [[Mitrinomon jetpack thruster]]s, making them [[Rocket boot/Legends|rocket boots]] as well.
